title: Notice on Which a Northbeam Returns and Restocking Collection Is Agreed
content:
The earliest day a collection may be booked for is the schedule's collection lead days of notice, counted in calendar days from the day the collection booking now standing on the return was recorded, the day it was recorded counted as day zero and the days that have already passed since then taken off, and the notice is never fewer than the floor this desk keeps for a collection agreed with a customer in person. The part of the day recorded on the collection is the one the customer agrees to when the slot is put to them, and no part of the day is recorded that the customer has not agreed to.

## The count, element by element

The notice in question is the notice on which a Northbeam Returns and Restocking collection is agreed.

| Element | What it is |
| --- | --- |
| the length | the collection lead days published against the return schedule the line falls under |
| the count | calendar days |
| day zero | the day the collection booking now standing on the return was recorded |
| what comes off, and where | the days that have already passed since that day; the days already passed since the booking was recorded are taken off last |
| the floor | 1 day, the floor this desk keeps for a collection agreed with a customer in person, applied after that subtraction |

The days already passed since the booking was recorded are taken off last, and the floor of 1 day is applied to what that subtraction leaves: the notice is that figure where it comes to 1 or more, and 1 day where it comes to fewer.

## Worked through on hypothetical inputs

*A return whose schedule publishes collection lead days of 4, the collection booking standing on it recorded 1 day ago.* The notice counted comes to 4 days; the 1 day already passed is taken off last, leaving 3 days, which is 1 or more, so the collection is agreed for 3 days from today.

*The same return, the booking recorded 4 days ago.* Four days less 4 comes to nothing, which is fewer than 1, so the notice is 1 day.

*The same return, the booking recorded 9 days ago.* Four days less 9 would fall below nothing; the floor of 1 day stands, and the notice is 1 day.

## The part of the day

The part of the day recorded on the collection is the one the customer agrees to when the slot is put to them. No part of the day is recorded that the customer has not agreed to.
